review_notes: I read the whole target file and the upstream definitions it uses: polynomialTangent, PolynomialNormal, PolynomialResidueField and polynomialResidueMap, all in PolynomialTangentDifferential.lean. The file's own definitions are three: primeNormalProjection, primeCoordinateNormals and primeLogarithmicNormals. Each is a thin named specialisation. primeNormalProjection is the mkQ of the tangent submodule. The other two compose that projection with Pi.basisFun and with frameBasis respectively. None is an independent competing version of a Mathlib concept. The rest of the file is theorems, and standalone theorem duplication is excluded by the rubric. The related definitions I read (polynomialTangent as the kernel of a Jacobian map, FractionRing quotients) are built from Mathlib notions and live in other files, so they are outside this file's scope. I found no clear case for consolidation, so I abstain.
